description: WHEN the drawing must leave as a real BIM file, openable in Revit/ArchiCAD/Solibri — not just a drawing. Draw a building scene and get an IFC4 file in millimetres: real spatial hierarchy (project/site/building/storeys), STABLE IFC GlobalIds (the same model keeps them across exports; pass projet_id; imported elements keep theirs), structural columns and beams (`poteaux[]`, `poutres[]` become IfcColumn, IfcBeam; see GET /cao/schema), one named IfcSpace per room with its areas (floor, French habitable and Carrez), floor slabs cut by their stair openings, an IfcRoof, IfcStair flights, standard Pset/Qto quantities, and material layers carrying density and thermal conductivity. Wall/slab/door/window types, 2nd-level space boundaries, and Lambert-93 georeferencing (EPSG:2154, Scale 0.001) are included so Revit/Archicad can open a typed, located model. Declare compositions{} to replace type compositions. Doors/windows really cut their host wall (IfcOpeningElement + IfcRelFillsElement). Passes IFC4 schema and EXPRESS-rule validation. Validate locally with cao_valider_ifc (no buildingSMART account). Call cao_verifier first. Same scene as cao_generer_dxf. Returns a JSON object {ifc, elements, unites, schema}: the IFC file arrives INLINE as text in `ifc` — no download URL, nothing stored server-side, so write it to a .ifc file yourself. `elements` counts the IFC objects emitted and `schema` names the IFC version produced. Set `armatures: true` to add the reinforcement: IfcReinforcingBar with exact geometry for footings and lintels (aggregated to their host), one IfcReinforcingMesh per slab.

armatures.description: Add the reinforcement computed per Eurocode 2 (bars and slab meshes).

boites.description: Boxes (furniture, volumes): a rectangular block placed by its CENTRE, not by a corner. Millimetres, same frame as murs[].

rotation.description: Rotation around the box centre, in DEGREES counter-clockwise (not radians). Default 0

x.description: Centre X of the box (mm) — not a corner

y.description: Centre Y of the box (mm) — not a corner

z.description: Underside height above the floor (mm). 0 = resting on the floor; raise it for a wall unit or a shelf

cercles.description: Circles on the 2D plan, alongside plan[] lines: each has a centre and a radius, in the same unit as the plan. Use for round shapes a polyline would render badly — fillets, posts, manholes.

x.description: Centre X, same unit as plan[]

y.description: Centre Y, same unit as plan[]

compositions.description: Named wall/slab layer sets declared by the project. A key that matches an inferred kind (mur_exterieur, refend, cloison, plancher, toiture) or murs[].composition drops the Hypothese flag. Each value is {libelle, couches: [{cle, epaisseur?}]}. cle: enduit, bloc_beton, isolant, ba13, ossature, enduit_platre, beton_arme, tuile, charpente, etancheite. Omit epaisseur on the load-bearing layer.

decoration.description: Paint/finish per wall — used only by cao_pdf. Colors the elevations (exterior face) and the axonometric view (face auto-detected by orientation relative to the building's centroid).

couleur.description: Hex color, e.g. '#e2e0d5' — default per type

electricite.description: Electrical symbols (outlets, switches, lights…) — used only by cao_pdf (dedicated technical plan + quantities), no effect on dxf/metres/render. Position: attached to a wall (`mur`+`position`, like ouvertures) or free (`x`,`y`).

z.description: Default per type (NF C 15-100-informed: outlets 30cm, switches 110cm; light/smoke detector/vmc default to ceiling height)

georef.description: Optional Lambert-93 (EPSG:2154) false origin for IfcMapConversion. Local millimetres are scaled by 0.001 to CRS metres. Do not invent coordinates: omit est/nord if unknown (origin stays 0). orientation is the angle in degrees of project X from map East, counterclockwise.

altitude.description: Orthogonal height in metres (NGF-IGN69 for Lambert-93).

est.description: Easting in metres in the CRS. Omit if unknown — never invent.

nord.description: Northing in metres in the CRS. Omit if unknown — never invent.

orientation.description: Angle in degrees of the project's X axis from map East, counterclockwise. Default 0.

murs.description: Walls: plan segments extruded vertically. Every coordinate in this whole scene is in MILLIMETRES, in a single plan frame whose origin you choose — X to the right, Y upward, Z up from the floor. Keep one consistent origin across murs/boites/plan: the generators never recentre anything for you.

composition.description: Optional key into the scene-level compositions object. When omitted, the exporter infers mur_exterieur / refend / cloison from geometry. A matching declared composition drops the Hypothese flag in the IFC.

couches.description: Optional inline material layers [{cle, epaisseur?}]. cle is one of enduit, bloc_beton, isolant, ba13, ossature, enduit_platre, beton_arme, tuile, charpente, etancheite. Omit epaisseur on the load-bearing layer so it takes the remainder of the wall thickness.

epaisseur.description: Wall thickness (mm), spread evenly on both sides of the axis — the axis is the centreline, not a face. Default 200

existant.description: Optional: true for a wall of the EXISTING building when the scene is an extension. cao_permis then counts as created only what the works add.

hauteur.description: Wall height (mm) from floor level. Default 2500, a usual French ceiling height

materiau.description: Optional single material key: the whole thickness becomes one load-bearing layer instead of a type composition.

x1.description: Start point X of the wall axis (mm)

x2.description: End point X of the wall axis (mm)

y1.description: Start point Y of the wall axis (mm)

y2.description: End point Y of the wall axis (mm)

ouvertures.description: Doors/windows embedded in a wall — used only by cao_pdf (elevations + axonometric view), no effect on dxf/metres.

hauteur.description: Opening height (mm), measured up from `z`. `z + hauteur` must stay under the wall height

largeur.description: Opening width (mm) measured along the wall, from `position`. Must fit inside the wall segment

mur.description: Index of the host wall in murs[] (0-based)

position.description: Distance in mm from the wall's start (x1,y1)

plan.description: 2D reference lines — drawn flat, never extruded and never counted in the quantities. Use them for axes, plot limits or setting-out marks.

x1.description: Start X (mm), same frame as murs[]

x2.description: End X (mm), same frame as murs[]

y1.description: Start Y (mm), same frame as murs[]

y2.description: End Y (mm), same frame as murs[]

plomberie.description: Sanitary fixtures (sink, WC, shower…) — used only by cao_pdf. Same positioning as electricite.

reseaux.description: Plumbing pipe runs (EF/EC/EU/EV/EP/chauffage) — used only by cao_pdf (technical plan + linear-meter quantities per type).

trace.description: At least 2 points (mm), freely drawn in plan

toitures.description: Roofs — used only by cao_pdf. WITHOUT this field: a flat roof is auto-generated over the footprint of ALL walls (legacy default). WITH it: compose freely — each entry can target a subset of walls (via `murs`), letting you build an L-shaped building's roof, or add a dormer on top of a main roof.

apex.description: Free apex position — 'personnalise' only (default: 'plat' if omitted)

debord.description: Eaves overhang (mm) on the auto footprint

murs.description: Wall indices this roof section covers (default: all walls). Ignored if `polygone` is given.

polygone.description: Custom footprint (mm) — overrides the auto rectangle. Any type except 'chien_assis'.

rotation.description: Ridge orientation in degrees — 'deux_pans' only (0 = along X axis)

y.description: 'chien_assis' only: center y — POSITION it on the carrying roof slope

z.description: Base altitude (mm) — default: top of the walls covered

name: cao_generer_ifc
title: Generate an IFC (BIM) model
